paragraphs.text: The Plains of Urlan (ER-lahn) are plains in Stonehaven , the western part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria . Before the Fall of Arathoxia , they were the domain of House Kavrel .

The Plains of Urlan are the northern plains of Stonehaven , crossed by the Tenamis River . On the Plains of Urlan, bone is like silver, and visionaries search the stars for signs. Its people are allies to any who would defend Corondor from conqueror wizards. The plains feature the ziggurat city of Hamath .
